text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The accommodation rip-off: How landlords are cheating their tenants.
- About 15 Nigerian fishermen have been declared missing after a series of attacks by Cameroonian gendarmes in the disputed Bakassi peninsula.
- Civil servants will soon benefit from loans from government's Petroleum Trust Fund to buy motorcycles and bicycles.
- United Nations General Assembly expresses deep concern about the human rights situation in Nigeria and urges the government to take steps to rectify it.
